summary: Guinea’s restoration pledges include 2,000,000 hectares under Bonn/AFR100, annual sequestration of 451 ktCO2/year unconditionally and 17,605 ktCO2/year conditionally, at least 5,000,000 trees yearly, and staged forest-and-watershed restoration of 10,000 hectares by 2030 and 25,000 by 2035, plus 5,000–10,000 hectares of mangroves by 2035. The 25,000-hectare program is about 0.15% of Guinea’s 169,501 km² of current forest, while the 2-million-hectare commitment equals 11.8%. Conservation combines preservation of 1,882,000 hectares, minimum 30% forest cover, 30% protected coverage by 2030, 560,000 and 1,000,000 improved stoves, and 1,500 km of firebreaks. Mixed measures include five basin plans, 20 stations, eight projects and 50 municipalities by 2035, and 10–20 transhumance corridors. Agriculture expands from 10,000 farms in 2030 to 25,000 farms and over 50,000 hectares by 2035, roughly 1% of current agriculture.
